meta.title: Work Experience - Skills Week, Aimed at Your Specialism

questions.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'This Is Round Two'? Select all that apply.
options: You can build on Year 1 evidence
questions.explanation: All of these are mentioned in the section on This Is Round Two.

questions.prompt: What are the college hours a placement must fit within?
questions.explanation: Placements must fit within college hours (8.30am-5.30pm), max 8-hour day.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'A Second Placement Has More Value'? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: All of these are mentioned in the section on A Second Placement Has More Value.

questions.prompt: What should you do if you are running late or unwell for placement?
options: Stay home and email your tutor only
Just turn up when you can
Contact the employer AND the college
questions.explanation: Running late or unwell? Contact the employer AND the college.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Connect Placement to Your Future'? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: All of these are mentioned in the section on Connect Placement to Your Future.

questions.prompt: What is the Year 2 framing of this work experience session?
options: Building on what you know - this is a fresh run at it, not a repeat test
Skip it - you did it last year
questions.explanation: You've done this once already - so this time we're building on what you know, not starting from zero.

questions.prompt: Why does a second placement matter more?
options: It counts as a third course
Two placements beat one: two CV entries, two referees, a portfolio that shows range as well as skill
questions.explanation: Two placements beat one: two entries on a CV, two referees, and a portfolio that shows range as well as skill.

questions.prompt: What happens if you don't get a placement by Skills Week?
options: You come into college for an employer-set brief and employer talks instead. It still counts
questions.explanation: No placement by Skills Week? You come into college for an employer-set brief and employer talks instead.
